metadata.title: Wet-Look Portrait with Vertical Sans-Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-key portrait of a person with wet, slicked-back auburn hair and blue eyes, set against a pale pink background. A vertical column of bold, white sans-serif text runs along the left edge, while a sharp, geometric shard-like overlay with dark blue and purple tones cuts across the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text alignment mirroring the verticality of the hair strands
Contrast between the soft pink background and the sharp, dark geometric overlay
High-contrast lighting emphasizing the texture of wet hair against smooth skin
Color harmony between the blue eyes and the blue tones in the geometric shard
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the left margin
Geometric collage element in the lower right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, filling approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one on the left, framed by wet hair strands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the mouth, then follows the vertical text on the left, and finally rests on the dark geometric shard on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily the pale pink areas around the head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale pink background and skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep auburn hair and dark eyeliner
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt blue and purple in the geometric overlay
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with high-saturation, low-value accents.

composition.scale: Large, spanning the height of the image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both name and title to maintain minimalist impact.
graphicDevices: Geometric shard overlay with internal texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, industrial feel of the lettering.
Provides the clean, geometric structure and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a person with wet auburn hair and blue eyes against a pale pink background. Include a dark, geometric shard overlay in the bottom right corner showing a distorted version of the hair texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, uppercase sans-serif text vertically along the left edge, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture visibly wet and glossy?
Does the geometric shard have sharp, clean edges?
Is the background a consistent pale pink?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility in vertical orientation
Ensure the geometric shard doesn't obscure the eyes
Verify the white text pops against the pink background
Confirm the wet hair look is realistic
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Wet Texture + Pale Background + Vertical Sans-Serif + Geometric Shard Overlay
